task_completion.description: Load the california_earthquakes.geojson file into QGIS.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'california_earthquakes' layer is visible in the QGIS Layers panel and point features are displayed on the map canvas.

task_completion.description: Open the IDW Interpolation tool from the Processing Toolbox.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'IDW Interpolation' dialog window is open on the screen.

task_completion.description: Configure the IDW tool using the 'mag' attribute and setting the pixel size/extent.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the IDW dialog, the Interpolation attribute is set to 'mag', and the Pixel Size (X and Y) is set to approximately 0.05 or the Rows/Columns are at least 100x100.

task_completion.description: Run the interpolation to create a continuous raster surface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new raster layer (often named 'Interpolated' or similar) appears in the Layers panel, showing a gradient surface rather than individual points.

task_completion.description: Export the resulting raster to the specified GeoTIFF path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Raster Layer as' dialog or a successful log message shows the output path /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/earthquake_magnitude_surface.tif.

task_completion.description: Save the QGIS project to the specified location.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The QGIS title bar shows 'earthquake_interpolation.qgz' or a 'Project Saved' message appears in the status bar with the path /home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/earthquake_interpolation.qgz.

integrity.description: The agent used the QGIS graphical interface rather than just executing shell commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with QGIS menus, toolboxes, and dialog windows.

integrity.description: The raster was generated through the tool, not by loading a pre-existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'IDW Interpolation' progress bar or the 'Interpolated' layer appearing immediately after tool execution.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific geojson file provided in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: The layer properties or the 'Add Vector Layer' dialog shows the path /home/ga/GIS_Data/california_earthquakes.geojson.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The input data contains earthquake magnitudes starting at 2.5. Therefore, the resulting IDW raster must have a minimum pixel value of 2.5 and a maximum value between 4.26 and 5.1. Any raster showing values outside the 2.5 to 5.1 range (e.g., 0 to 10) is likely incorrect or uses default placeholder scales. The output must be a GeoTIFF at /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/earthquake_magnitude_surface.tif and the project at /home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/earthquake_interpolation.qgz.
